findings.text: Only two of the four surfaces moved to the one component. The mobile sheet (`ext/drawer/rail.js:53`) and the desktop drawer's AI tab (`ext/drawer/tabs/ai.js:194`) now call `chat()`. The AI 2 card sidebar (Servex `agents/Layers.js` page-ai, the old `assistant-<card>` with its model chooser) and the dev bar's chat mode are not touched, and `/api/page-ai` still does not feed the pair. That was ask 1, the main point of the task.

The font is fixed by adding a style, which is what ask 5 ruled out ("fix it by where it mounts, not by adding CSS"). `ux/Dictate/chat.js:417` `fix_font()` copies `.theme-lew42`'s font onto the mount as an inline style. The real cause is named in `ext/drawer/readme.md:157`: `drawer.js` `build()` queries `.app` before it exists and falls back to `<body>`. Fix `build()` so it waits for the app or uses the View captor chain, then delete `fix_font`.

Every time the drawer's AI tab opens, it leaks a poller and an EventSource. `tabs/ai.js:199` calls `chat()` and never keeps the handle or calls `remove()`. Each re-fill of the drawer runs `ai()` again (`tabs.js:118` → `drawer(this.fill)`), which adds another 1.5 s `Session.watch` poll (`ext/Session/Session.js:102`), another `Session.stream` EventSource and another `subscribe(attach)` listener. The detached widgets keep all of these alive for the life of the page. Call `mount.remove()` when the tab's content is replaced.

Ask 3 is only partly done. `Session.nav()` gets `{from, to}` pages only (`chat.js:486`). There is no card in the event, even though `rail.js:101` `sync_card()` reads the card and then drops it. Nothing in the diff logs `pause start` / `pause end`, and nothing routes refinement to the card that is selected at the time.

Ask 4 is not addressed: chat and card do not yet share one content model. The chat still draws through `Widget`'s own bubble path (`chat.js:588` `draw()` → `panel.say({chat})`), and the diff never renders the card's content widgets from JSONL lines.

The diff has no screenshot proof. The brief asks for every surface at 400 and 1920 before each merge, but `shots/` holds only `before-drawer-ai-3440.png`. Nothing proves the mobile rail did not regress, or that the sheet collapses to one line (ask 2).

The Sessions tab lists voice sessions "on this page" (`tabs/sessions.js:278`, `Session.recent(page)`). A global session started on another page won't show up there, even when it is the live one. Now that sessions are global, list the browser tab's recent sessions instead.

`ago()` is now copied three times (`chat.js:430`, `tabs/sessions.js:249`, rail.js), which breaks law 6. `sessions.js` already imports `chat.js`, so export `ago` from there and have the others import it.

The good part: `chat.js`'s single controller (one `sessionStorage` session, `watch()` from line 0 on every mount, `own_ats` de-dupe, `report_nav` dedupe) is simple and is the right core. findings.text: On a global session that started on a card, a refinement can be filed under the wrong card (ask 3). `chat.js` `ensure()` passes `target.card` to `Session.start()`, so `create()` stores `s.card`. After that, `card_at()` (Sessions.js, the new `if (s.card) return s.card`) always returns that first card, even after the owner has moved to another card. Only sessions homed on a card should skip the lookup. Store the starting card as the first `nav` card instead, or keep a separate flag for "homed on a card".

When the owner deselects a card in the sheet, the change is never reported. `rail.js:1119` and `rail.js:1123` pass `this.card_ref?.id`, which is `undefined` when no card is selected. `chat.js` `nav(path, card)` treats `undefined` as "keep the old card", so the deselect is lost. Pass `null` for "no card" (`?.id ?? null`), and let `nav()` tell `undefined` apart from `null`.

A doc comment is now out of date and will mislead the next reader. The `chat.js` class doc (diff lines 669–673) says "`rail.js` is outside this merge's fence and still calls `nav(path)` with no card", but this same diff updates `rail.js` to pass the card. Delete that warning.

The diff only covers ask 3 (nav card, pause, refinement card), plus `recent_project` and selection. Asks 4 (one content model), 6 (the page that shows each surface) and the mobile collapse in ask 2 are not in this diff. The earlier `review/report.md` findings 4–6 still stand unless another merge closed them. The card should say which merge covers which ask.

There's a simpler way to catch "pause end". `Session.js` `report_pause()` checks `mic_floor.owner` every 400 ms, on every page that loads `chat.js`, for the life of the tab. `floor.js` already has `mic_on()`. One `on_mic` listener there, next to `on_quiet`, would replace the poll. Also, the first time the mic turns on, an `end` is posted with no `start` before it.

`Sessions.js` `nav()` tells the fast assistant "the owner moved to X" even when only the card changed and the page stayed the same (`report_nav` now fires on a card-only change). Wording like "now on X, card Y" would be more accurate.

`select()` and `say({selection})` store whatever object the browser sends, including `selection.text`, with no size limit (Sessions.js `select`). A large selected block lands in every `select` line, and in the prefix of every sentence's line. Cap or trim `text`.

Several `files.jsonl` hunks only add duplicate lines that are already in the file: `ext/drawer/doc/files.jsonl` adds `sheet.md` and `inbox*.png` again, `walkthrough/shots/files.jsonl` adds `inbox-coordinated-400.png` again, and `ai2/files.jsonl` adds a stray `ai/` gone/un-gone line. This is noise in the merge; drop it.

Good: `node Servex/agents/Sessions.test.mjs` passes 9/9 in the `one-dictation` worktree. Replacing the two-query `project_recent()` workaround in `tabs/sessions.js` with `/api/sessions?project=1` is the right simplification.
